k:職.mnemonic: The sentry stands with his halberd (戈), ear (耳) cocked for the slightest sound (音). That gate is where he was assigned, and he will not leave it. Post (employment, work).

k:丸.mnemonic: Nine (九) with a drop (丶) added: roll the drop of dough nine times between your palms and it becomes a perfect ball. Round (perfection, pills).

k:勢.mnemonic: Thousands of legs (儿) kick up the soil (土) as round (丸) cannonballs are hauled forward: an army's power (力) on the move. Forces (energy, military strength, spirit).

k:案.mnemonic: You relax (安) under a tree (木) with a notebook and sketch out, at your leisure, how the whole thing will be done. Plan (suggestion, draft, ponder).

k:旅.mnemonic: She pins up her hair with a hairpin (𠂉), picks a direction (方) and sets off down the road with her bag. Trip (travel).

k:施.mnemonic: On a desert trip (旅) a scorpion (也) crawls into the tent. Somebody has to actually do it: scoop it up and take it outside. Carry out (give, alms, perform).

k:派.mnemonic: An axe (斤) of rock under the overhang (厂) splits the tsunami (氵) of water into separate streams, each going its own way and refusing to rejoin. Faction (group, party, clique).

k:休.mnemonic: Even the leader (亻) gets tired. He leans his back against a tree (木) and shuts his eyes for a while. Rest (day off, retire, sleep).

k:候.mnemonic: The leader (亻) fixes an arrow (矢) to a handle (ユ) on the roof to make a weather vane, and watches it turn through the seasons. Climate (season, weather, wait for).
k:候.hint: Arrow weather vane on the roof.

k:張.mnemonic: Draw the bow (弓) and the string pulls out long (長) and taut, as far as your arm will go. Stretch (spread).

k:補.mnemonic: The cloak (衤) has a hole, so the task (用) is to sew on ten (十) small patches until what was missing is made good. Supplement (supply, make good, compensate).
k:補.hint: Patching the hole in a cloak.

k:震.mnemonic: Rain (雨) hammers down in a storm, and the clam (辰) clamps shut and shivers in its shell as the whole seabed trembles. Quake (shake, tremble, quiver).

k:違.mnemonic: Two travellers on the path (辶), one wearing tanned hide (韋) and one wearing raw fur. Anyone can tell at a glance which is which. Difference (differ).
k:違.hint: Leather versus fur on the road.

k:港.mnemonic: The sea wall coils round like a cobra (已), and inside it the water lies as calm as in a well (井) while a tsunami (氵) rages beyond. Harbor.
k:港.hint: Calm water inside a coiled wall.

k:待.mnemonic: You stroll (彳) up and down in front of the temple (寺) gate, glancing at the clock, until your friend finally turns up. Wait (depend on).

k:末.mnemonic: A book (本) of six (六) chapters: you finish chapter six and there is nothing after it but the back cover. Last (end, tip, close).

k:条.mnemonic: The village laws are carved on a tree (木), one to a branch, and the clerk trudges (夂) round it reading each numbered one aloud. Article (clause, twig, item).

k:独.mnemonic: A hound (犭) lying in an empty yard, with only one insect (虫) buzzing round its nose for company. Single (alone, spontaneously, Germany).

k:態.mnemonic: Two cooks with equal ability (能): one slouches and sighs, the other puts her heart (心) into every dish. What differs is how they carry themselves. Attitude (condition, figure, appearance).

k:程.mnemonic: The king (王) paces out his borders himself, to find just how far the harmony (和) of his kingdom reaches. Extent (degree, law, distance).

k:規.mnemonic: A big (大) measuring post is set in the soil (土) where every person (人) can see (見) it. All lengths in the market are checked against it. Standard (measure).

k:若.mnemonic: Flowers (艹) tucked behind the right (右) ear: the fashion among those still in their teens, with all their life ahead of them. Young (if, perhaps, possibly).

k:守.mnemonic: A guard paces every measurement (寸) of the roof (宀), inch by inch, all night, so that no thief gets in. Protect (guard, obey, defend).
k:守.hint: Pacing every inch of the roof.

k:復.mnemonic: After the storm he trudges (夂) out at dawn (旦) and sets every fallen stone back in place, until you can stroll (彳) down the lane just as before. Restore (return to, revert, resume).

k:司.mnemonic: One mouth (口) gives the word, and the job counts as complete (了) only when that mouth says so. Director (official, rule, administer).

k:深.mnemonic: The tsunami (氵) floods the valley. The water passes your legs (儿), then your forehead (冖), and soon only the top of a tree (木) still shows. Deep (heighten, intensify, strengthen).
